families.name: 图神经网络与医学拓扑

verification_note: Building the website does not rerun experiments. Historical records retain the original run ID and digest.

models.title: AlexNet
models.core_mech: 以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。
models.core_mech_en: First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.

models.title: ResNet
models.core_mech: 显式 identity shortcut 与残差相加 y=x+F(x)。
models.core_mech_en: Explicit identity shortcut connections combined with additive residual learning y = x + F(x).

models.title: DenseNet
models.core_mech: 每层对所有前层输出做通道 concat，而非仅连接相邻层或做残差相加。
models.core_mech_en: Every layer concatenates feature maps from all preceding layers along the channel axis rather than summing adjacent residuals.

models.title: ConvNeXt
models.core_mech: 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer 加 inverted bottleneck 的现代纯卷积块。
models.core_mech_en: Modernized pure ConvNet block pairing a 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer with an inverted channel bottleneck.

models.title: FCN
models.core_mech: FC→Conv 的整图 dense prediction，加 pool3/pool4 分数级 skip fusion。
models.core_mech_en: Converts image-level FC layers into 1×1 convolutions for arbitrary-size dense prediction with pool3/pool4 skip score fusion.

models.title: U-Net
models.core_mech: 对称 U 形多尺度解码器与 encoder–decoder 同尺度 concat long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.

models.title: 3D U-Net
models.core_mech: 把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。
models.core_mech_en: Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.

models.title: V-Net
models.core_mech: 3D residual FCN 与直接可微 Dice overlap objective 的结合。
models.core_mech_en: Volumetric 3D residual encoder–decoder trained directly with a differentiable Dice overlap objective.

models.title: nnU-Net
models.core_mech: dataset fingerprint 驱动的自配置、交叉验证与推理后处理闭环，而不是单一新算子。
models.core_mech_en: Dataset-fingerprint-driven self-configuration, 5-fold cross-validation ensembling, and post-processing loop rather than a new neural block.

models.title: UNETR
models.core_mech: 多深度 ViT token skips 连接到卷积 U 形解码器的 3D hybrid。
models.core_mech_en: 3D hybrid segmentation architecture connecting multi-depth Vision Transformer token representations to a convolutional U-shaped decoder.

models.title: Swin UNETR (SSL)
models.core_mech: 3D shifted-window hierarchy 与旋转、重建、对比联合自监督的 Swin UNETR。
models.core_mech_en: 3D shifted-window hierarchical Swin encoder coupled to a U-shaped CNN decoder and pretrained with multi-task 3D self-supervision.

models.title: MedNeXt
models.core_mech: 贯穿 encoder、decoder 和上下采样的全 3D 大核 depthwise ConvNeXt block。
models.core_mech_en: Fully 3D large-kernel depthwise ConvNeXt blocks deployed uniformly across encoder, bottleneck, decoder, and residual up/downsampling.

models.title: Models Genesis
models.core_mech: 多种 3D 变形与遮挡的统一恢复式自监督，而非从 2D ImageNet 迁移。
models.core_mech_en: Unified restorative 3D self-supervised learning from non-linear intensity, local pixel shuffling, and in-/out-painting perturbations.

models.title: VISTA3D
models.core_mech: 127 类自动分支、3D 点提示分支和 supervoxel 蒸馏共存的统一 3D segmentation FM。
models.core_mech_en: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model integrating a 127-class automated branch, a 3D point-prompt branch, and 2D supervoxel distillation.

models.title: S4
models.core_mech: 结构化 A 矩阵使线性 SSM 可在长卷积训练与递推推理间等价切换。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes state matrix A as Normal Plus Low-Rank (NPLR) so linear SSMs switch exact equivalence between O(N log N) convolutional training and O(1) recurrent inference.

models.title: Mamba
models.core_mech: 由当前输入生成 Δ、B、C 的 selective SSM，并用硬件感知并行 scan 执行。
models.core_mech_en: Makes SSM discretization step Δ and projections B, C functions of the current input x_k, executed via a hardware-aware parallel associative scan.

models.title: VMamba
models.core_mech: SS2D 将二维网格沿四个方向 selective scan 后再逆映射融合。
models.core_mech_en: 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) unfolds spatial feature maps along four directional traversal paths, applies selective SSMs, and merges them back.

models.title: U-Mamba
models.core_mech: 在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds flattened 1D selective Mamba blocks inside an nnU-Net-style residual CNN encoder/bottleneck while retaining CNN decoder and long skips.

models.title: SegMamba
models.core_mech: GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。
models.core_mech_en: Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.

models.title: Transformer
models.core_mech: 无递归的多头 self-attention encoder 与 masked self-/cross-attention decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Recurrence-free multi-head self-attention encoder paired with a masked self- and cross-attention decoder.

models.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
models.core_mech: 非重叠 patch 线性 token 化、CLS 汇聚与全局 Transformer encoder，完全移除卷积主干。
models.core_mech_en: Splits images into non-overlapping patches, linearly projects them into tokens with positional embeddings, and processes them via a pure global Transformer encoder.

models.title: Swin Transformer
models.core_mech: W-MSA 与 SW-MSA 交替实现局部高效注意力和跨窗连接，并以 patch merging 形成层次金字塔。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates regular Windowed Multi-Head Self-Attention (W-MSA) with Shifted-Window Attention (SW-MSA) across a patch-merging multi-scale pyramid.

models.title: Mask2Former
models.core_mech: 上一层预测 mask 反向约束下一层 query cross-attention 的迭代集合分割。
models.core_mech_en: Iterative set-prediction segmentation where predicted foreground masks from layer l-1 constrain query cross-attention in layer l.

models.title: SimCLR
models.core_mech: 无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。
models.core_mech_en: Trains an encoder and non-linear MLP projection head via in-batch NT-Xent contrastive loss across dual augmented views without momentum queues.

models.title: MoCo
models.core_mech: 由 EMA key encoder 维护一致编码、由 FIFO queue 提供大规模跨 batch 负样本的对比字典。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples contrastive negative dictionary size from mini-batch size using a FIFO queue of encoded keys updated via a momentum (EMA) encoder.

models.title: MAE
models.core_mech: 高比例随机遮蔽后仅编码可见 patch，再用轻量 decoder 重建 mask patch 的非对称自编码器。
models.core_mech_en: Asymmetric autoencoder that masks 75% of image patches, encodes only the 25% visible tokens with a heavy ViT, and reconstructs pixels via a lightweight decoder.

models.title: DINO
models.core_mech: 无负样本的 EMA teacher–student 跨视图概率匹配，以 centering 与 sharpening 防止塌缩。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-distillation where a student ViT matches the centered, temperature-sharpened probability distribution of an EMA teacher across multi-crop views.

models.title: iBOT
models.core_mech: EMA teacher 同时充当在线视觉 tokenizer，以图像级 DINO 蒸馏和被遮 patch token 蒸馏联合训练。
models.core_mech_en: Uses the EMA teacher simultaneously as an online visual tokenizer to jointly distill masked patch tokens alongside global [CLS] self-distillation.

models.title: DINOv2
models.core_mech: 以 LVD-142M 数据策展配合 DINO+iBOT+KoLeo 复合自监督，并通过跨尺寸蒸馏形成模型家族。
models.core_mech_en: Combines automated deduplication/retrieval curation (LVD-142M) with a composite DINO + iBOT + KoLeo objective and multi-resolution distillation.

models.title: CLIP
models.core_mech: 完全分离的图像/文本双塔，通过批内 N×N 对称对比目标对齐，并用文本 prompt 充当开放词表分类器。
models.core_mech_en: Aligns separate image and text encoders in a shared embedding space via symmetric in-batch N×N contrastive loss, turning text prompts into zero-shot classifiers.

models.title: BLIP-2
models.core_mech: Q-Former 的 learnable queries 作为冻结图像 encoder 与冻结 LLM 之间唯一可训练的视觉信息瓶颈。
models.core_mech_en: Bridges a frozen pretrained image encoder to a frozen LLM using a lightweight Querying Transformer (Q-Former) with learnable query tokens as an information bottleneck.

models.title: Segment Anything (SAM)
models.core_mech: 可缓存的重型 image encoder、轻量 prompt encoder 与双向 attention mask decoder 解耦，并以动态 hypernetwork 输出多候选 mask。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples a heavy cacheable ViT image encoder from a lightweight spatial prompt encoder (points/boxes/masks) and an ambiguity-aware two-way attention mask decoder.

models.title: MedSAM
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式架构上以大规模多模态医学分割监督做领域适配，并将 box prompt 作为稳定的目标定位接口。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the promptable SAM architecture across 1.57 million medical image–mask pairs spanning 10 imaging modalities using bounding-box prompts.

models.title: SAM 2
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式 decoder 外加入 memory attention、mask-conditioned memory encoder 和 object pointer，构成可交互的流式时序闭环。
models.core_mech_en: Extends promptable SAM with a streaming memory bank, memory cross-attention, mask-conditioned memory encoder, and occlusion score head across sequences.

models.title: ConVIRT
models.core_mech: 将自然生成的医学图像–报告对输入全局双塔，通过双向跨模态对比预训练医学视觉 encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains medical visual encoders directly from naturally occurring paired radiology images and free-text reports via bidirectional contrastive loss.

models.title: GLoRIA
models.core_mech: 在全局图文对比之外，以词为 query 对 CNN region grid 做软 attention 并训练局部区域–词对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Combines global image–report contrastive alignment with word-queried soft attention over local CNN image grid regions for fine-grained phrase grounding.

models.title: BioViL
models.core_mech: 以放射报告专用 CXR-BERT 提升文本语义，再联合学习检查级图文对比与短语–视觉 patch grounding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a radiology-specialized text encoder (CXR-BERT with RSM masked pretraining) with joint global and local patch–phrase contrastive alignment.

models.title: BiomedCLIP
models.core_mech: 以 PMC-15M 广域生物医学 figure–caption 语料、ViT 视觉塔和 PubMedBERT 文本塔训练领域 CLIP。
models.core_mech_en: Domain-specific CLIP trained on PMC-15M (15 million biomedical figure–caption pairs from PubMed Central) using a ViT vision tower and PubMedBERT text tower.

models.title: UNI
models.core_mech: 在超过一亿病理图块上以 DINOv2 式 teacher–student 训练 ViT-L/16，向多类病理任务提供统一冻结 tile encoder。
models.core_mech_en: ViT-L/16 tile encoder pretrained via DINOv2 self-distillation and iBOT masked patch modeling on over 100 million H&E histopathology patches (Mass-100K).

models.title: CONCH
models.core_mech: 在病理领域把 CLIP 式全局对比与 CoCa 式图像条件 caption decoder 联合训练，同时服务判别与生成。
models.core_mech_en: CoCa-style computational pathology vision–language foundation model jointly trained with contrastive image–text alignment and generative caption decoding on 1.17M pairs.

models.title: Prov-GigaPath
models.core_mech: DINOv2 病理 tile encoder 与 LongNet 膨胀注意力 slide encoder 两级串联，并以 masked tile reconstruction 预训练全切片上下文。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage gigapixel pathology foundation model pairing a DINOv2 tile encoder with a LongNet dilated-attention whole-slide encoder pretrained via masked tile reconstruction.

models.title: Merlin
models.core_mech: 以 I3D ResNet-152 原生编码完整 CT，并用 EHR phenotype prediction 与 Clinical Longformer 报告对比进行多源多任务预训练。
models.core_mech_en: Native 3D abdominal CT foundation model encoding whole volumes with an I3D ResNet-152 supervised jointly by EHR diagnosis codes (phenotypes) and radiology reports.

models.title: Deep Autoencoder
models.core_mech: 逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。
models.core_mech_en: Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.

models.title: GAN
models.core_mech: 生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。
models.core_mech_en: Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.

models.title: pix2pix
models.core_mech: 以 U-Net 生成器保持逐像素空间对应，70×70 conditional PatchGAN 学局部真实感，并用配对 L1 锚定结构。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a U-Net generator (preserving pixel-level spatial alignment) with a 70×70 conditional PatchGAN discriminator and paired L1 structural anchoring.

models.title: CycleGAN
models.core_mech: 双生成器、双 PatchGAN 与 X→Y→X / Y→X→Y 两个 cycle L1 闭环，使不成对域转换可训练。
models.core_mech_en: Couples dual generators (G: X→Y, F: Y→X) and dual PatchGAN discriminators with forward and backward L1 cycle-consistency loops for unpaired translation.

models.title: FBPConvNet
models.core_mech: 解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。
models.core_mech_en: Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.

models.title: Learned Primal-Dual
models.core_mech: 同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新，并在每个 unrolled stage 显式调用 A 和 A*。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls primal–dual proximal optimization into K stages of paired measurement-domain (dual) and image-domain (primal) residual CNNs calling A and A* at every stage.

models.title: Variational Network
models.core_mech: 把多线圈 MRI 的变分梯度下降展开，并联合学习卷积滤波器、势函数与每级更新权重。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K steps of gradient descent on a generalized Fields-of-Experts variational energy for multi-coil MRI, jointly learning convolutional filters, non-linear potentials, and data weights.

models.title: MoDL
models.core_mech: 共享 CNN prior 与可微共轭梯度 data-consistency 子问题交替展开。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates a weight-shared multi-layer CNN denoiser prior D_θ with a differentiable numerical Conjugate Gradient (CG) solver enforcing exact data consistency (A*A + λI)^{-1}.

models.title: VarNet
models.core_mech: 灵敏度估计网络加多级 k-space variational cascades，将图像正则与采样点 DC 工程化为统一流程。
models.core_mech_en: End-to-End Variational Network combining a joint U-Net coil sensitivity estimation module (SME) with K k-space variational cascades using U-Net image regularizers.

models.title: DnCNN
models.core_mech: 深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).

models.title: Noise2Noise
models.core_mech: 使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.

models.title: Noise2Self
models.core_mech: 通过 J-invariant 遮挡使单幅 noisy image 同时提供输入与 held-out 监督目标。
models.core_mech_en: Formalizes single-image self-supervised denoising via J-invariant functions whose prediction for pixel subset J does not depend on the observed noisy values in J.

models.title: DDPM
models.core_mech: 预设离散高斯前向链，加训练稳定的 epsilon/score 网络，再按学习到的随机逆链逐步采样。
models.core_mech_en: Defines a fixed discrete Markov Gaussian forward noising chain and trains a noise-prediction U-Net (ε_θ) across all noise scales for iterative reverse sampling.

models.title: DDIM
models.core_mech: 在相同 DDPM 训练边缘下采用隐式非 Markov、可确定性的跳步轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs non-Markovian, deterministic reverse sampling trajectories that share the exact same marginal training distributions as DDPM.

models.title: Score-SDE
models.core_mech: 以连续 score field 同时定义 reverse-time SDE、predictor-corrector sampler 与同边缘的 probability-flow ODE。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies discrete diffusion and score matching into a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) with a corresponding deterministic Probability-Flow ODE.

models.title: Latent Diffusion
models.core_mech: 先以 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上运行可 cross-attention 条件化的 diffusion。
models.core_mech_en: Perceptually compresses high-resolution images into a lower-dimensional spatial latent grid via a VQ/KL autoencoder before running cross-attention-conditioned diffusion.

models.title: DDRM
models.core_mech: 在退化算子 SVD 基中把预训练 diffusion prior 与线性观测条件分量逐时间步耦合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples an unconditional pretrained diffusion prior with a linear forward operator y = Hx + z by running conditional reverse diffusion in the SVD spectral domain of H.

models.title: DPS
models.core_mech: 在每个 diffusion 逆时间步，把预训练先验 score 与经 x0 估计反传的测量 likelihood gradient 相加。
models.core_mech_en: Approximates intractable time-dependent measurement likelihood scores ∇_{x_t} log p_t(y|x_t) via backpropagation through the Tweedie posterior mean estimate x̂_0(x_t).

models.title: DiffusionMBIR
models.core_mech: 把预训练 2D diffusion slice prior 嵌入 3D MBIR/data-consistency 外循环，并显式加跨切片约束。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds a pretrained 2D slice diffusion score prior into an alternating 3D Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) loop with explicit z-axis total variation regularization.

models.title: Flow Matching
models.core_mech: 在已知 probability path 上回归 velocity（而非 score），再直接积分神经 ODE 完成分布运输。
models.core_mech_en: Trains continuous normalizing flows without ODE simulation by directly regressing the marginal vector field u_t(x) along conditional probability paths.

models.title: Rectified Flow
models.core_mech: 以直线端点路径训练 velocity，并通过 reflow 重新耦合端点以进一步拉直 ODE 轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Learns an ODE velocity field along straight linear interpolations x_t = (1−t)x_0 + t x_1 and iteratively straightens trajectories via reflow recoupling.

models.title: Consistency Models
models.core_mech: 学习沿 PF-ODE 轨迹不变的 endpoint map，使任意噪声尺度可直接一步映射到 clean sample。
models.core_mech_en: Learns a self-consistent function f_θ(x_t, t) = x_ε that maps any point along a Probability-Flow ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin in a single step.

models.title: DiT
models.core_mech: 把 noisy latent patch 化，以 adaLN-Zero 条件化的 Transformer blocks 作为 diffusion score/velocity backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone in Latent Diffusion with an isotropic Vision Transformer over latent patches conditioned via Adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (adaLN-Zero).

models.title: Spatial Transformer Network
models.core_mech: 定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。
models.core_mech_en: Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.

models.title: VoxelMorph
models.core_mech: 3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。
models.core_mech_en: Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.

models.title: GradICON
models.core_mech: 通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。
models.core_mech_en: Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.

models.title: uniGradICON
models.core_mech: 将 GradICON 在异质多数据集上联合训练为单一通用注册器，支持 zero-shot 与目标域微调。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a single multi-step GradICON architecture jointly across heterogeneous multi-organ, multi-modality datasets to serve as a zero-shot registration foundation model.

models.title: DiffPose
models.core_mech: 合成 DRR 训练的 pose initializer 与可微 X-ray renderer 驱动的 SE(3) 测试时优化闭环结合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples a patient-specific SE(3) pose initializer (trained self-supervised on synthetic DRRs) with test-time gradient optimization through a differentiable X-ray ray-casting renderer.

models.title: X2CT-GAN
models.core_mech: 双正交 2D 编码器将特征提升并融合到 3D，再以体素重建和 3D adversarial loss 联合监督。
models.core_mech_en: Lifts features from two orthogonal (bi-planar PA + lateral) 2D chest X-rays into 3D via backprojection-inspired feature expansion and cross-view fusion supervised by 3D voxel + GAN losses.

models.title: NeRF
models.core_mech: 位置编码坐标 MLP 预测连续密度与视角相关颜色，再沿相机射线做可微体渲染。
models.core_mech_en: Represents a continuous 3D scene as a 5D coordinate MLP (x,y,z,θ,φ) → (σ, c) with Fourier positional encoding, optimized via differentiable emission–absorption volume rendering.

models.title: NAF
models.core_mech: 以 hash-encoded 坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并用 Beer–Lambert 重投影误差逐病例优化。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites NeRF for cone-beam CT by replacing view-dependent emission–absorption with an isotropic X-ray linear attenuation field μ(x) optimized via Beer–Lambert reprojection error and hash encoding.

models.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
models.core_mech: 显式优化各向异性 3D Gaussians，并通过屏幕空间 splatting 与自适应增密实现实时 radiance rendering。
models.core_mech_en: Represents 3D scenes explicitly as millions of anisotropic 3D Gaussians (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics) rendered in real time via differentiable tile-based rasterization.

models.title: GCN
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: 以加自环的对称归一化邻接执行共享线性变换后的固定权重邻居聚合。
models.core_mech_en: First-order spectral graph convolution approximation that aggregates 1-hop neighbor features weighted by the symmetrically normalized adjacency matrix with self-loops.

models.title: GAT
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: 对预定义邻域内的边计算 masked multi-head attention，再以数据依赖权重聚合邻居特征。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces fixed degree-normalized edge weights with content-dependent multi-head masked self-attention coefficients α_{ij} computed over 1-hop graph neighborhoods.

models.title: LSTM
models.core_mech: 带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。
models.core_mech_en: Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.

models.title: Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)
models.core_mech: 以因果、指数扩张的 1D 卷积残差块并行覆盖长历史，而不使用循环状态。
models.core_mech_en: Stacks 1D causal convolutions with exponentially increasing dilation factors d = 2^l inside residual blocks to cover long historical receptive fields in parallel.

models.title: HeartBEiT
models.core_mech: 将标准版式 ECG 渲染为图像，以 BEiT 式离散 masked-patch prediction 预训练专用 ViT。
models.core_mech_en: Renders standard 12-lead ECG waveforms as 2D layout images and pretrains a Vision Transformer via BEiT-style discrete masked patch token prediction on 8.5 million ECGs.

models.title: LaBraM
models.core_mech: 以 VQ neural tokenizer 提供离散 EEG patch 目标，再用跨通道/时间 Transformer 做 masked code prediction。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a vector-quantized (VQ) neural spectrum tokenizer to predict Fourier amplitude/phase spectra of EEG patches, then pretrains a cross-channel Transformer via masked code prediction.

models.title: VGG-16/19
models.core_mech: 以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。
models.core_mech_en: Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.

models.title: GoogLeNet / Inception-v1
models.core_mech: 在每个 Inception module 中并行执行 1×1、降维后 3×3/5×5 和 pooling 分支，再通道拼接。
models.core_mech_en: Parallel multi-scale branches (1×1, bottlenecked 3×3, 5×5 convolutions, and pooling) concatenated within each Inception module.

models.title: ResNeXt
models.core_mech: 在 residual bottleneck 中以 cardinality 控制的 grouped 3×3 convolution 聚合多个等拓扑变换。
models.core_mech_en: Aggregates multiple homogeneous residual branches via grouped 3×3 convolutions governed by a cardinality hyperparameter.

models.title: SENet
models.core_mech: 全局平均池化 squeeze 后经 bottleneck MLP 产生每通道 sigmoid 门，对卷积特征逐通道重标定。
models.core_mech_en: Global average pooling (Squeeze) followed by a lightweight bottleneck MLP (Excitation) producing per-channel sigmoid gates.

models.title: EfficientNet
models.core_mech: 以 NAS 设计的 MBConv+SE 基线配合 depth/width/resolution 三维 compound scaling。
models.core_mech_en: NAS-discovered MBConv+SE baseline scaled jointly across depth, width, and input resolution via a compound coefficient φ.

models.title: U-Net++
models.core_mech: 以 X_i,j 嵌套稠密卷积节点重写 U-Net 跳连，并从多个顶层节点施加深监督。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites U-Net skip pathways as a dense nested grid of intermediate convolutional nodes X_{i,j} with multi-depth deep supervision.

models.title: Attention U-Net
models.core_mech: 由粗尺度 decoder gating signal 计算空间 attention coefficients，在拼接前逐位置筛选 encoder skip。
models.core_mech_en: Computes spatial soft-attention coefficients α ∈ [0,1] from coarse decoder gating signals to filter encoder skips prior to concatenation.

models.title: H-DenseUNet
models.core_mech: 先以 2D DenseUNet 学切片内细节，再将特征堆叠进 3D DenseUNet，并通过 hybrid feature fusion 联合预测。
models.core_mech_en: Extracts intra-slice features via a 2D DenseUNet, stacks them into a 3D DenseUNet, and fuses both via a hybrid feature fusion (HFF) layer.

models.title: DeiT
models.core_mech: 增加 distillation token 和专用 head，使 CNN teacher 信号通过 Transformer attention 注入 ViT。
models.core_mech_en: Augments ViT with a learnable distillation token that interacts with patch tokens via self-attention to distill inductive biases from a CNN teacher.

models.title: PVT
models.core_mech: 以逐级降低 token 分辨率的 Transformer pyramid 和 spatial-reduction attention 提供多尺度 dense-prediction backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs a progressive four-stage token pyramid using Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) to compress K/V resolution before attention.

models.title: SegFormer
models.core_mech: 层级 MiT 编码器结合 overlap patch、K/V 缩减 attention 与含 depthwise Conv 的 Mix-FFN，再接全 MLP 轻量 decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with overlapping patches, sequence-reduced attention, and 3×3 depthwise Mix-FFN paired with an all-MLP decoder.

models.title: BEiT
models.core_mech: BEiT 的辨识点是预测外部 tokenizer 产生的离散视觉码，而非 MAE 式像素重建或普通对比学习。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains Vision Transformers via BERT-style Masked Image Modeling by predicting discrete visual tokens generated by an external dVAE tokenizer.

models.title: BYOL
models.core_mech: 没有负样本队列或聚类码本，核心稳定器是 stop-gradient、EMA 教师和仅在线侧存在的 predictor。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-supervised representation learning stabilized by an asymmetric online predictor MLP, stop-gradient, and an EMA target encoder.

models.title: SwAV
models.core_mech: 以在线平衡原型分配作为跨视图预测目标，区别于 BYOL 的 EMA 表示回归和 SimCLR 的实例负样本。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces pairwise instance comparisons with online Sinkhorn-Knopp balanced prototype cluster assignment and swapped cross-view prediction.

models.title: ALIGN
models.core_mech: ALIGN 的主要贡献不是新交互模块，而是简单 EfficientNet/BERT 双塔在十亿级未精洗图文对上的规模化训练。
models.core_mech_en: Demonstrates that a simple EfficientNet + BERT dual encoder trained on over one billion noisy web image–alt-text pairs learns robust cross-modal representations.

models.title: BLIP
models.core_mech: 区别于纯双塔，BLIP 用共享 MED 同时承担对齐、跨注意力匹配和因果生成，并把 captioner-filter 作为数据循环的一部分。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies vision–language understanding and generation via a Multimodal Mixture of Encoder–Decoder (MED) coupled with a CapFilt data bootstrapping loop.

models.title: Florence-2
models.core_mech: 核心不是增加多个 head，而是用任务提示和位置 token 将 caption、检测、grounding、分割全部改写为 seq2seq。
models.core_mech_en: Reformulates captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, and segmentation into a single prompt-driven sequence-to-sequence generation task with quantized coordinate tokens.

models.title: MedCLIP
models.core_mech: MedCLIP 的关键不是更深双塔，而是用医学知识构造任意图像—文本间的软语义配对。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces hard binary 1-to-1 image–report pairing with a soft semantic similarity matrix derived from clinical entity extraction, enabling unpaired contrastive learning.

models.title: Med-Flamingo
models.core_mech: 区别于单一投影接 LLM，Med-Flamingo 用 Perceiver 固定视觉 latent，并在多层冻结 LLM 中反复注入门控跨注意力。
models.core_mech_en: Compresses variable-number medical images via a Perceiver Resampler and injects them into a frozen LLM through tanh-gated cross-attention layers for few-shot in-context learning.

models.title: LLaVA-Med
models.core_mech: 其贡献主要是将 LLaVA 两阶段训练移到生物医学域：PMC 图注概念对齐后再做合成医学指令微调。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the LLaVA visual-instruction-tuning paradigm to biomedicine via two-stage training: PMC figure–caption alignment followed by GPT-4-synthesized biomedical instruction tuning.

models.title: RadFM
models.core_mech: RadFM 的模型特异性在于统一 2D/3D 视觉 encoder 与 Perceiver 扫描聚合，再接生成式 LLM。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies 2D radiographs and 3D volumetric scans (CT/MRI) via a 2D/3D ViT + Perceiver 3D aggregator feeding into a generative radiology LLM.

models.title: MAIRA-1
models.core_mech: MAIRA-1 不是通用图文预训练模型，而是冻结胸片 RAD-DINO、使用四层 adapter，并完整微调 Vicuna-7B 的专用报告生成器。
models.core_mech_en: Specialist chest X-ray report generator pairing a frozen CXR-specific RAD-DINO visual encoder, a 4-layer MLP adapter, and a fully fine-tuned Vicuna-7B LLM.

models.title: MAIRA-2
models.core_mech: 相较 MAIRA-1，MAIRA-2 增加多视图/既往/报告上下文，并把报告句子与生成式 bounding-box token 绑定。
models.core_mech_en: Extends MAIRA-1 with multi-view (AP/PA + lateral), prior study/report longitudinal context, and interleaved quantized bounding-box tokens for grounded reporting.

models.title: BiomedGPT
models.core_mech: BiomedGPT 以模态无关、任务无关的 encoder—decoder token 化接口统一生物医学视觉、语言和多模态输出。
models.core_mech_en: Modality- and task-agnostic encoder–decoder Transformer unifying biomedical images, clinical text, and bounding boxes into a discrete token sequence interface.

models.title: Virchow
models.core_mech: Virchow 是 632M ViT-H/14 的病理 tile foundation encoder，以约 150 万临床 WSI 的 DINOv2 自监督规模取胜。
models.core_mech_en: 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 computational pathology tile foundation model pretrained with DINOv2 on 2 billion tiles from 1.5 million clinical H&E whole-slide images.

models.title: CHIEF
models.core_mech: CHIEF 明确串联 CTransPath tile 自监督和带解剖条件的 WSI attention 弱监督，而非只发布局部 patch encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Couples self-supervised tile encoding (CTransPath) with anatomical-site-conditioned whole-slide attention aggregation trained across 60,530 WSIs.

models.title: TITAN
models.core_mech: TITAN 的特异性是三阶段 whole-slide 预训练：特征网格 iBOT、ROI caption CoCa、WSI report CoCa。
models.core_mech_en: Three-stage multimodal whole-slide foundation model pretrained via iBOT on 2D tile feature grids, CoCa on synthetic ROI captions, and CoCa on whole-slide pathology reports.

models.title: PRISM2
models.core_mech: PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.

models.title: BME-X
models.core_mech: BME-X 不是通用 MRI encoder，而是先预测组织标签、再用组织感知 DU-Net 生成增强图像的两阶段恢复模型。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage brain MRI enhancement foundation model that first estimates tissue probability maps and then conditions a Dual U-Net (DU-Net) to restore harmonized images.

models.title: Prima
models.core_mech: Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.

models.title: MARS
models.core_mech: MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。
models.core_mech_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.

models.title: Decipher-MR
models.core_mech: Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: 3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.

models.title: Noise2Void
models.core_mech: Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。
models.core_mech_en: Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.

models.title: RED-Net
models.core_mech: 相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。
models.core_mech_en: Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.

models.title: SwinIR
models.core_mech: SwinIR 把多个带卷积残差的 RSTB 置于浅层卷积和任务重建头之间，以移窗注意力服务高分辨率恢复。
models.core_mech_en: Sandwiches multiple Residual Swin Transformer Blocks (RSTBs, each ending in a 3×3 convolutional residual) between a shallow CNN extractor and a reconstruction head.

models.title: Restormer
models.core_mech: Restormer 用 MDTA 在通道维做转置注意力，并以 GDFN 门控深度卷积替代普通 Transformer FFN。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces spatial N×N self-attention with Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) across channels (C×C) paired with a Gated-Dconv Feed-Forward Network (GDFN).

models.title: AUTOMAP
models.core_mech: AUTOMAP 的标志是大规模全连接层直接承担 domain transform，而非先做 FBP/IFFT 再用 CNN 后处理。
models.core_mech_en: Learns the sensor-to-image domain transform directly via large fully connected layers mapping flattened raw measurements to an image grid followed by sparse convolutional refinement.

models.title: LEARN
models.core_mech: LEARN 每个展开阶段并行计算 CT 数据梯度和 learned experts CNN 正则梯度，再做残差更新。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K iterative sparse-view CT reconstruction stages where each stage combines an explicit projection residual gradient A^T(Ax^t − y) with a stage-specific 3-layer CNN regularizer.

models.title: DDNM
models.core_mech: DDNM 用 A†y 固定 range-space 信息，只让 diffusion denoiser 生成 null-space 分量。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes reverse diffusion intermediate estimates x̂_{0|t} via the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse A† into a fixed measurement range-space component A†y and a generated null-space component (I − A†A)x̂_{0|t}.

models.title: RealNVP
models.core_mech: RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.

models.title: Glow
models.core_mech: Glow 在 RealNVP coupling 上加入数据依赖 ActNorm 和可学习可逆 1×1 通道卷积。
models.core_mech_en: Enhances multi-scale affine coupling flows with activation normalization (ActNorm) and learnable invertible 1×1 channel convolutions parameterized via LU decomposition.

models.title: PFGM++
models.core_mech: PFGM++ 用可调增广维度 D 的 Poisson 电场统一 PFGM 与 diffusion，而不是固定高斯前向噪声过程。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds N-dimensional data on the z=0 hyperplane of an N+D augmented space and learns the high-dimensional Poisson electric field lines, unifying PFGM (D=1) and Diffusion (D→∞).

models.title: SiT
models.core_mech: SiT 将 DiT 放入 stochastic interpolant 框架，用统一模型显式比较 velocity、score 和 diffusion 参数化。
models.core_mech_en: Places the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone inside a continuous-time Stochastic Interpolant framework to systematically decouple interpolation schedules, model targets, and samplers.

models.title: LapIRN
models.core_mech: LapIRN 把配准写成 Laplacian 金字塔上的三层残差流：每层先 warp，再让下一层只修正剩余误差。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes large-deformation 3D registration into a 3-level coarse-to-fine Laplacian image pyramid where each level warps the previous estimate and refines only the residual displacement.

models.title: TransMorph
models.core_mech: TransMorph 用层级 Swin encoder 取代纯 CNN 配准编码器，同时保留 U-Net 式 decoder 和可微 warping。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional encoder in VoxelMorph with a 3D hierarchical Swin Transformer encoder while retaining a convolutional U-Net decoder and Spatial Transformer warping.

models.title: IDIR
models.core_mech: IDIR 将位移场本身作为坐标神经场，并在测试图像对上直接优化，而不是由训练好的网络一次预测 flow。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes the continuous 3D deformation field φ(x) = x + u_θ(x) for a single image pair directly as a coordinate-based Implicit Neural Representation (SIREN MLP) optimized at test time.

models.title: DeepDRR
models.core_mech: DeepDRR 不是纯 GAN 渲染器，而是 3D 材料分解网络、解析材料/能谱 ray tracing、学习散射和解析噪声的组合 forward model。
models.core_mech_en: Physics-based X-ray fluoroscopy simulator combining CNN 3D tissue material decomposition, analytical energy-dependent Beer–Lambert ray-casting, learned Rayleigh/Compton scatter, and quantum noise.

models.title: pixelNeRF
models.core_mech: pixelNeRF 将每个 3D 点与其投影像素的 CNN 特征绑定，使 NeRF 从单场景优化器变为跨场景条件模型。
models.core_mech_en: Conditions a coordinate NeRF MLP on pixel-aligned 2D CNN feature vectors projected from 1 or a few input views, turning NeRF from a per-scene optimizer into a feed-forward cross-scene prior.

models.title: Instant-NGP
models.core_mech: Instant-NGP 的速度来自可学习多分辨率 hash-grid encoding 和空空间跳跃，而不是更深的 NeRF MLP。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces fixed sinusoidal positional encodings with a multi-resolution hierarchy of learnable hash tables paired with a tiny fused-CUDA MLP, accelerating neural fields by 100×–1000×.

models.title: MedNeRF
models.core_mech: MedNeRF 把 NeRF 置于 GAN 式跨病例生成先验中，以 shape/appearance latent 从单 X-ray 合成视角，而非逐场景多视图优化。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts GIRAFFE/GRAF 3D-aware generative radiance fields to X-ray projections, disentangling 3D shape and appearance latents to synthesize continuous-angle CT projections from a single X-ray.

models.title: EndoNeRF
models.core_mech: EndoNeRF 以时间条件 deformation MLP 把动态组织映射到 canonical NeRF，并显式利用手术器械 mask。
models.core_mech_en: Reconstructs deformable soft-tissue scenes from single-viewpoint stereo robotic endoscopy by pairing a canonical static NeRF with a time-conditioned deformation field and tool occlusion masks.

models.title: GraphSAGE
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: GraphSAGE 学的是可应用到新节点的聚合器，并用固定邻居采样实现归纳式 mini-batch GNN。
models.core_mech_en: Inductive graph representation learning that samples fixed-size K-hop neighborhoods and applies learnable aggregator functions (mean, LSTM, pooling) to generalize to unseen nodes.

models.title: Graphormer
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: Graphormer 不做局部消息传递堆叠，而在全局 attention logits 中显式加入最短路径和边特征偏置。
models.core_mech_en: Enables global all-pair Transformer self-attention over graphs by injecting degree centrality encodings into nodes and shortest-path spatial + edge-feature biases into attention logits.

models.title: Voxel2Mesh
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: Voxel2Mesh 不先分割再 marching cubes，而由 3D 体素特征逐级驱动球形模板的 GCN 形变和细分。
models.core_mech_en: Deforms a sphere template mesh progressively into a target 3D anatomical surface via Graph Convolutions conditioned on 3D CNN voxel features sampled at mesh vertices.

models.title: Vox2Cortex
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.core_mech: Vox2Cortex 将 3D U-Net 特征在顶点处采样，并以 GCN 同时形变四个互相关联的皮层表面。
models.core_mech_en: Jointly deforms four topologically coupled brain cortical hemisphere templates (left/right white and pial surfaces) in seconds using 3D U-Net voxel features and Residual GCNs.

models.title: GRU
models.core_mech: GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。
models.core_mech_en: Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.

models.title: ECGFounder
models.core_mech: ECGFounder 是 RegNet/Net1D 风格的 1D CNN foundation model，以超过千万波形和 150 类监督规模为核心，不应误写为通用 Transformer SSL。
models.core_mech_en: 1D RegNet-style residual CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks pretrained via multi-label clinical supervision across >10 million 12-lead ECGs and 150 diagnostic categories.

models.title: PhyDiCT
models.core_mech: 在固定预训练三维扩散先验上交替施加投影观测约束与去噪更新；文本报告、几何和预训练权重都是显式条件。
models.core_mech_en: A frozen text-conditioned 3D diffusion prior is guided by differentiable projection consistency during inference; reports, geometry and pretrained weights are explicit conditions.
